# Typography

17 tokens in the `typography` group.

| Token | Type | Value | CSS Variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `typography.body-md` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.normal}","fontSize":"\{font-size.md}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.normal}"}` | `--storm-typography-body-md` | Default body text style: Storm Sans regular at 18px (`font-size.md`) with normal line height. Use it for paragraphs, descriptions and most running copy. BodyText uses it by default, as do the components built on BodyText. |
| `typography.body-sm` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.normal}","fontSize":"\{font-size.sm}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.normal}"}` | `--storm-typography-body-sm` | Smaller body text style: Storm Sans regular at 16px (`font-size.sm`) with normal line height. Use it for secondary copy in dense layouts, such as table rows, sidebars and card metadata, where `body-md` would feel too large. |
| `typography.button` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.semibold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.md}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.tight}"}` | `--storm-typography-button` | Button label style: Storm Sans semibold at 18px (`font-size.md`) with tight line height so labels center cleanly inside fixed-height controls. Use it for text inside actionable triggers. Used by Button and LinkText. |
| `typography.caption` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.normal}","fontSize":"\{font-size.sm}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.tight}","fontStyle":"italic"}` | `--storm-typography-caption` | Caption style: Storm Sans regular italic at 16px (`font-size.sm`) with tight line height. Use it for helper text, annotations and small supporting labels. Used by Field helper and validation text, ValidationText, EyebrowText, Slider value labels and the CodeBlock header file name. |
| `typography.code` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Google Sans Code","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.normal}","fontSize":"\{font-size.lg}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-code` | Monospace code style: Google Sans Code regular at 20px (`font-size.lg`) with snug line height. Use it for source code, file paths, identifiers and other literal values. Used by CodeBlock, InlineCodeText, FileTree, Stepper and code content inside Accordion. |
| `typography.display-hero` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.semibold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.5xl}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-hero` | Largest display style: Storm Sans semibold at 60px (`font-size.5xl`) with snug line height. Reserve it for a single hero headline per page, such as a landing or marketing banner. HeadingText applies it for `level="hero"` (rendered as an h1). |
| `typography.display-lg` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.semibold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.3xl}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-lg` | Large display style: Storm Sans semibold at 36px (`font-size.3xl`) with snug line height. Use it for page titles and top-level section headings. HeadingText applies it for levels `1`/`title` (h1) and `2`/`lg` (h2). |
| `typography.display-md` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.bold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.xl}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-md` | Medium display style: Storm Sans bold at 24px (`font-size.xl`) with snug line height. Use it for section and card headings. HeadingText applies it for level `3`/`md` (h3) and as its default font. |
| `typography.display-sm` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.bold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.lg}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-sm` | Small display style: Storm Sans bold at 20px (`font-size.lg`) with snug line height. Use it for subsection headings and dialog or panel titles. HeadingText applies it for level `4`/`sm` (h4). |
| `typography.display-xs` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.semibold}","fontSize":"\{font-size.md}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.tight}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-xs` | Extra small display style: Storm Sans semibold at 16px (`font-size.md`) with snug line height. Use it for minor headings and compact text elements. HeadingText applies it for level `5`/`xs` (h5). |
| `typography.display-xxs` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.medium}","fontSize":"\{font-size.sm}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.tight}"}` | `--storm-typography-display-xxs` | Extra extra small display style: Storm Sans medium at 14px (`font-size.sm`) with tight line height. Use it for minor headings and compact text elements. HeadingText applies it for level `5`/`xs` (h5). |

Use it for page titles and top-level section headings. HeadingText applies it for levels `1`/`title` (h1) and `2`/`lg` (h2). |

Use it for section and card headings. HeadingText applies it for level `3`/`md` (h3) and as its default font. |

Use it for the short kicker or category label that sits directly above a heading. Used by EyebrowText. |
| `typography.title-lg` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.medium}","fontSize":"\{font-size.md}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.tight}"}` | `--storm-typography-title-lg` | Large title style: Storm Sans medium at 18px (`font-size.md`) with snug line height. Use it for form labels, column headers and other short labels that sit above content. Used by LabelText (resting label), DataTable column headings and TypeTable column labels. |
| `typography.title-sm` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","fontWeight":"\{font-weight.normal}","fontSize":"\{font-size.xxs}","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}` | `--storm-typography-title-sm` | Small title style: Storm Sans regular at 12px (`font-size.xxs`) with snug line height. Use it for compact labels that must stay out of the way of their content. LabelText switches to it when `floating` is set, such as a field label that has floated up into the input border. |
